name: You.com
summary: You.com's cited Answer, Research and Finance Research APIs.
notes: Auth is the X-API-Key header. YOU_API_KEY is read first, then YDC_API_KEY, the name You.com's own docs use.
Web Search and Contents are served from a different host (ydc-index.io) and are not in this entry; web-router's search and extract already cover them.
Research effort drives latency and cost: lite under 10s up to frontier, which can run for hours.
The Images endpoint is beta and unmaintained, and the Inference Router is not covered here.

endpoints.name: Get a cited answer
endpoints.summary: A synthesized answer with citations and the web results behind it.

query.example: What is the Model Context Protocol?

freshness.description: day, week, month, year, or a date range string.

include_domains.description: Strict allowlist of domains, up to 500; not with exclude_domains.

exclude_domains.description: Domains to exclude, up to 500; not with include_domains.

boost_domains.description: Domains to prefer in ranking, up to 500.

notes: A read over POST: it answers a question and changes nothing in your account.

endpoints.name: Run a research query
endpoints.summary: Multi-step research with cited synthesis; set background to run it as a task.

input.description: The research question, up to 40,000 characters.
input.example: How are EU data-residency rules changing for AI vendors?

research_effort.description: How much work to spend; lite answers under 10s, standard (default) 10-30s, deep under 120s, exhaustive under 300s, frontier up to 12000s.

source_control.description: Beta. Allow, block or boost specific domains.

output_schema.description: Beta. JSON Schema subset for structured output in output.content.

background.description: true returns a task handle at once instead of waiting for the answer.

notes: A read over POST: it runs research and changes nothing in your account (higher effort costs more).
With background true, poll research.get with the returned task id.

endpoints.name: Get a background research task
endpoints.summary: Status of a background research task; result is null until it completes.

endpoints.name: Run a finance research query
endpoints.summary: Research tuned for financial questions, with multi-step reasoning and citations.

input.example: How did NVIDIA's data-center revenue change last quarter?

output_schema.description: Beta. JSON Schema subset for structured output.

notes: A read over POST: it runs research and changes nothing in your account.

endpoints.name: Get the credit balance
endpoints.summary: Remaining credits for the billing entity behind the API key.
